main:1.text: Professor Fig and I have travelled via Portkey to a remote cliffside in the Scottish Highlands. We need to explore the mysterious ruins that we suspect the Portkey was meant to lead us to. While searching through a ruined castle in the Scottish Highlands, I happened upon a strange glowing doorway made of crystallised stone. Suddenly Professor Fig and I found ourselves in an ornate vestibule.

main:2.text: I need to head to my common room. Sounds as though there are some voices coming from nearby – perhaps I should follow them. I should probably introduce myself to some of my fellow students, however uncomfortable it may be. I should probably introduce myself to some of my fellow students, however uncomfortable it may be.

main:3.text: The Field Guide Map shows Professor Ronen's class is in the Astronomy Wing. This castle is enormous! I may need to use the Charmed Compass in the Field Guide to help me find the way. Professor Ronen has set up a Gobstones-inspired game to test the class's Accio abilities, and he's asked me to demonstrate for the class. I need to practise summoning each of the three balls.

main:4.page: Defence Against the Dark Arts Class
main:4.text: The Field Guide Map shows Professor Hecat's class is in the lower section of the Astronomy Wing. I could get lost in this castle. I may need to use the Charmed Compass in the Field Guide to help me find the way. Professor Hecat wants me to attack the training dummy with a Basic Cast.

main:5.text: Professor Weasley wants to see me in her classroom which is off the Transfiguration Courtyard, located between the Library Annex and the Astronomy Wing. Hopefully she has word on replacing my lost supplies. I met with Professor Weasley and she's arranged for me to go to Hogsmeade with a companion. I've decided to invite Natty as she seems to be a good witch to have on your side.

main:6.text:
If you chose Sebastian, the quest objectives will use his name instead of Natty's. If the player is not at Lv2 and/or has not learned Reparo:
I need to progress in my studies and complete Professor Ronen's Assignment to learn Reparo before going to Hogsmeade with Natty.

main:7.text: Come and see me. I've discovered something in the locket we found at Gringotts. I need to tell Professor Fig about the troll attack in Hogsmeade, and I'd like to find out if he's learned more about the locket we found in Gringotts. Professor Fig found a map that leads to something in the Restricted Section. He wants me to visit Professor Hecat before we go any further.

main:8.text:
If the player is not at Lv3 and/or has not learned Incendio:
I need to complete Professor Hecat's assignment before I can continue with this quest I should report back to Professor Fig and let him know that I've learned Incendio. To get into the Restricted Section, I'm going to need to convince Sebastian Sallow to tell me how. He's never far from the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom.

main:9.text: Fig will be interested to see the book I found below the Restricted Section. I should take it to him. I brought the book that I found below the Restricted Section to Professor Fig. He was impressed, but disappointed to find that several pages were missing. He wants to study the book and see if he can glean any information from it. I think we are going to need those pages.

main:10.text: Meet me in Lower Hogsfield as soon as possible. I would like to talk with you about Rookwood and Harlow, and it might be best to do so outside of the castle. Natty Onai has asked me to meet her at a hamlet called Lower Hogsfield, just south of Hogwarts. I should see what she wants.If the player is not at Lv4: I met Natty Onai in Lower Hogsfield, where I discovered Floo Flames.

main:11.text: I need to attend Herbology class, taught by Professor Garlick in the Greenhouses. I should speak to Professor Garlick so I can get started on the assignment she has for me. I need to use the Potting Table to plant a dittany seed. Seems simple enough.

main:12.text:
If the player is not at Lv4:
I need to progress in my studies before I can attend Potions class. The next class I must attend is Potions. It is taught by Professor Sharp. I need to collect the ingredients for my potion, as well as a Fwooper Feather for Garreth Weasley.

main:13.text: A woman needs help just across the water beyond the dock. How dare these thieves harass people right in the shadow of Hogwarts? If they want a fight, I'll give it to them. Now that we've fought off Rookwood's men, I should make sure the woman is unharmed.

main:14.page: The Hunt for the Missing Pages
main:14.text: Sir Nicholas, our house ghost, is looking for you. You can find him near the Great Hall. Nearly Headless Nick may have information regarding the missing pages I seek. Sir Nicholas says he knows something about the missing pages. I'll hear him out, but where is he leading me?

main:15.text: Greetings. I understand you're quite the enterprising young Ravenclaw. Professor Fig tells me you found a long-lost book for him. I'd like to talk to you about it. My friend Eleazar Fig is aware that I've been searching for a family heirloom for some years now, alas to no avail. He suggested that you might be just the one to find it. Please stop by the shop at your earliest convenience.

main:16.text: A portrait in our common room wants to talk to you. It's Eldritch Diggory. He used to be the Minister for Magic, I think. The portrait of Eldritch Diggory, former Minister for Magic, may have some information for me. Eldritch Diggory wants me to travel to Upper Hogsfield and speak to Helen Thistlewood, his great-niece and a retired Auror.

main:17.text: Greetings, young Slytherin. Scrope knows about the old book you found for Professor Fig. Get to the courtyard past the pendulum. If you don't know it, you'll see it easy enough. And don't tell anyone what you're up too – especially Professor Black.

main:18.text:
If the player has not learned Expelliarmus:
I need to learn the Disarming Charm before I can follow Richard Jackdaw's ghost into the Forbidden Forest The ghost of Richard Jackdaw is going to meet me at the edge of the Forbidden Forest. He said he'll show me how to get to the cave where he died. He's certain the missing pages are still there with his decapitated remains.

main:19.text:
If the player is not at Lv6:
I need to progress in my studies before I can attend Flying Class. In today's Flying class, Madam Kogawa is reviewing basic broom flight and manoeuvrability. Madam Kogawa wants us to fly our brooms through each of the elevated rings.

main:20.text: Please meet me in the seventh-floor corridor as soon as you can. I have an idea for somewhere you can focus on your studies – away from prying eyes and distractions. Professor Weasley has requested I meet her in the seventh-floor corridor of the Astronomy Tower. This is an odd location for a meeting. I wonder what she wants. I've discovered what Professor Weasley calls the Room of Requirement.

main:21.page: In the Shadow of the Undercroft
main:21.text: I've not forgotten about our library venture – how did you fare? If you're keen for some illicit spell practice, meet me outside the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom. I know a discreet place near there.

main:22.text: Come and see me as soon as you can. I've returned from a rather unproductive trip to the Ministry. Hoping your time has been more fruitful than mine. Now that Professor Fig has returned, I'm excited to show him the missing pages and the secret map chamber I found below the school.If the player is not at Lv10: The entrance to the Map Chamber is just down the spiral staircase, hidden in the floor of a disused stone…

main:23.text:
I need to meet Professor Fig outside the tower.
If the player is not at Lv11: It can't possibly be a coincidence that goblins are here. What do they know about the tower? I need to look for evidence to explain why the goblins are here. One way or another, I'm going to need to get past these goblins to get inside.

main:24.text: I need to attend Beasts class, taught by Professor Howin.If the player is not at Lv13: Professor Howin has asked me to brush Gerald the Puffskein. I should use the Beast Petting Brush that Poppy gave me. Now I need to give Gerald the Puffskein some food. Poppy has given me some Beast Feed for him.

main:25.text: I hope you will come and see me about a pressing and highly confidential matter at your earliest convenience. I believe that we may be able to help each other. Gladwin Moon, the Hogwarts caretaker, wishes to speak with me about something. I should find him near the Reception Hall.If the player is not at Lv14: Gladwin wants me to remove the moon from the Demiguise statue.

main:26.text:
If the player is not at Lv12 and/or has not learned Depulso:
I need to progress in my studies and complete Professor Sharp's Assignment to earn Depulso before continuing on with this. I need to travel to Hogsmeade. I should be able to find Sirona inside the Three Broomsticks. Sirona said that the goblin I'm looking for is named Lodgok – he's known to frequent the Hog's Head Inn.

main:27.page: In the Shadow of the Estate
main:27.text: As I mentioned, my sister Anne misses Hogwarts and she hasn't been herself lately. I'd like to take you up on your promise to visit her with me. I'm heading to Feldcroft soon, so I'll look forward to seeing you there. It's just south of Hogwarts. By the way, hope you're faring well with the Blasting Curse. It's still one of my favourites.

main:28.page: The Elf, the Nab-Sack, and the Loom
main:28.text: Now that you've attended Beasts class, I've asked Deek to assist you in using the Room to further your studies in that regard. Deek wants to teach me how to use the nab-sack to rescue magical beasts. I need to talk to Deek about heading out to search for magical beasts to rescue with the nab-sack.

main:29.text:
Meet me near the ruins of Falbarton Castle. After dark. If the player is not at Lv17 and/or has not learned Wingardium Leviosa:
I need to complete Professor Garlick's assignment before I can continue with this quest. The main gate is locked. I should look for a way to climb the walls of the battlements and enter the Gatehouse.

main:30.text:
If the player is not at Lv16:
I need to progress in my studies before I can attend Astronomy class. Professor Shah's class is at the top of the Astronomy Tower, upstairs from the entrance to the Room of Requirement. I should head there now. Amit offered me his old telescope. Its somewhere in the storage area under the observation deck.

main:31.text: I assume you have news regarding the goblin you mentioned. Why don't we meet at the Map Chamber to discuss that and our next steps? Professor Fig is in the Map Chamber. I should speak to him about recent events. I met with Professor Fig in the Map Chamber and updated him on my dealings with Lodgok. The portrait of Charles Rookwood advised me that the next trial is at his former residence, Rookwood Castle.

main:32.text: Percival Rackham and Charles Rookwood want me to complete Charles's trial as soon as possible. I need to meet Professor Fig at Rookwood Castle. The castle is crawling with Victor Rookwood's people and Ranrok's Loyalists. We'll need to get past them to get into the castle. Professor Fig and I made our way into Rookwood Castle. We overheard Ranrok and Victor Rookwood arguing over their failed attempts to find me.

main:33.text:
Natty told me about your run-in with the poachers. I have some news about them as well. Can you meet me soon? I fear that some of what I uncovered has to do with you. If the player is not at Lv19:
I need to progress in my studies before meeting Poppy north of Hogwarts. Poppy is waiting in the area to the far north of Hogwarts, as the broom flies.

main:34.text: Anne is getting worse. If there is any chance that the relic from Slytherin's spellbook can help her, I must find it. I'm requesting your help. Meet me outside of Feldcroft, near the catacomb.

main:36.text: The Headmistress Speaks is a main quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Main Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

main:38.text: Niamh Fitzgerald was one of the Keepers and once the Headmistress of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Fitzgerald attended Hogwarts, where she was sorted into Ravenclaw. Eventually she became the school's Headmistress.

main:39.text: In the Shadow of Hope is Sebastian Sallow's sixth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

main:41.text: San Bakar's Tower is a location in the North Ford Bog. The Floo Flame of the same name is near the entrance to the tower.

main:44.text: In the Shadow of Revelation is a main quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest consists of a conversation cutscene that occurs immediately after the end of The Final Repository. The conversation is with either Sebastian Sallow or Ominis Gaunt, depending on the choice made during In the Shadow of Fate; if that quest has not been completed, the conversation will be with Sebastian.

main:45.text: Weasley's Watchful Eye is a main quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Main Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

main:46.text: The House Cup is the final main quest in Hogwarts Legacy. It consists solely of a cutscene celebrating the end of the school year and announcing the winner of the House Cup. This quest does not count towards the Complete Main Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:1.text: I have learned of a wizard who is being harassed by Harlow. He may be able to provide the evidence we need to take Harlow down. We should speak with him together. Meet me at his home.

side:2.text: My mother would like to speak with me. I believe she has learned about some of what we've been up to. I am hoping she may be easier on me if you are there. Natty believes that her mother, Professor Onai, may have discovered what we've been up to. She hopes that her mother will go easier on her if I am there when they speak.

side:4.text: Grief and Vengeance is Natsai Onai's fourth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:5.text: Finding Focus is Natsai Onai's fifth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:8.text: Can we meet at the Three Broomsticks? It may finally be safe since we rescued the dragon from Horntail Hall. I haven't heard anything to imply that the poachers are looking for us or the dragon egg we took. After rescuing a dragon from the clutches of the Poacher Pack, Poppy is ready to discuss our next move. She wants to meet in the Three Broomsticks.

side:13.text: It's in the Stars is Poppy Sweeting's sixth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:16.page: In the Shadow of the Bloodline
side:16.text: Sebastian and Ominis were seen arguing in the Great Hall. I should find out what this is about. After seeing Sebastian and Ominis arguing, I went to find out what happened. Sebastian told me that evidently Salazar Slytherin had a secret Scriptorium here at Hogwarts and that Ominis knows where to enter.

side:17.page: In the Shadow of the Study
side:17.text: I pressed Ominis regarding Salazar Slytherin's scriptorium, but my efforts were in vain. Meet me outside the Slytherin common room. We need to talk.

side:18.text: I've been studying Salazar Slytherin's spellbook. Meet me in the Undercroft. I've found something. Sebastian sent me an owl saying he found something interesting in the book from the Scriptorium and he wants to discuss it in the Undercroft. Unbeknownst to Sebastian and me, Ominis arrived in the Undercroft and overheard our entire conversation. Ominis is furious. Perhaps I should try to reason with him.

side:19.text: Anne is getting worse. If there is any chance that the relic from Slytherin's spellbook can help her, I must find it. I'm requesting your help. Meet me outside of Feldcroft, near the catacomb.

side:20.text: After the troubling events that transpired in Feldcroft, Sebastian wants to meet with me in the Undercroft. Sebastian is desperate to talk to Anne now, but since he has been banished, he must find a way to do it without Solomon knowing. He devised a plan to send her a message along with a crest she gave him as a child, so she'll know it's from him. He says that he'll be in touch soon.

side:21.text: In the Shadow of Hope is Sebastian Sallow's sixth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:22.page: In the Shadow of the Relic
side:22.text: At the end of this quest there is an opportunity to learn Avada Kedavra from Sebastian. If you turn it down, you can still learn it later by talking to him in the Undercroft; however that option may become unavailable after In the Shadow of Fate, depending on the choice made during that quest.

side:23.text: In the Shadow of Fate is Sebastian Sallow's eighth relationship quest in Hogwarts Legacy. This quest does not count towards the Complete Side/Relationship Quests challenge, so XP is not earned for completing it.

side:24.text: Depending on the choice made during In the Shadow of Fate, this quest is a conversation with either Sebastian Sallow or Ominis Gaunt, and this is reflected in the quest's card image. Regardless of choice, the associated achievement will unlock.

side:25.text: I require assistance with a delivery and thought you might be interested. Please visit me at J. Pippin's Potions if you'd like to earn a few coins. Parry Pippin of J. Pippin's Potions in Hogsmeade sent me an owl regarding a delivery. I should speak with him if I'm looking for some simple work.

side:26.text: I wonder if you might stop by the Three Broomsticks when you can. I would like your help with something. Sirona, the proprietress of the Three Broomsticks in Hogsmeade, sent me an owl requesting I meet with her at my earliest convenience. I should find out what she needs. I need to travel to Upper Hogsfield and speak with Dorothy Sprottle about her Horklump needs and ask her about Sirona's box of letters.

side:27.text:
The vendor in Irondale seems to be upset about something. I should introduce myself and see what the matter is. If it isn't night yet:
Mr Haggarty mentioned that the thief always comes at night. I should return to Irondale then. Since the thief comes at night, I should check around Irondale for clues.

side:29.text: All's Well That Ends Bell is a side quest in Hogwarts Legacy. It is received by speaking to Evangeline Bardsley in the Astronomy Wing.

side:30.text: Rumour has it Samantha Dale is having a problem with her brother William. I ought to see if I can help her. Samantha noted that her ancestral family tomb is located east of Brocburrow. I should look there.

side:31.text: Miss Moffett pointed me to the location of the Diricawl Den, but Gwyneira only appears at night."

side:32.text: The local vendor in Upper Hogsfield, Claire Beaumont, seems worried about something. I should ask her what's wrong. I spoke with Claire Beaumont and she needs someone to clear out a couple goblin encampments up the road. with[sic] these encampments disrupted, trading can resume in Upper Hogsfield. I've taken out both goblin encampments near Upper Hogsfield.

side:33.text: Dorothy Sprottle is concerned about a missing person. Perhaps I can help track them down. Bardolph allegedly practised Dark Magic near the Forest. I should start my search there. I need to return to Upper Hogsfield to tell Claire Beaumont about her brother Bardolph's fate. But how do I tell her that he'd become an Inferius? And, even worse, that I had to destroy him? This is going to be difficult.

side:34.text: I saw Arthur Plummly studying two treasure maps he had found. I should see if he needs any help. The first clue shows a rhinoceros skeleton on display. I know I must have walked by that at least a dozen times. Now if only I could remember where it is. It looks as if I'm supposed to find a dragon fountain. The tree in the background makes me think it's in a courtyard. A door behind it has been circled.

side:35.text: A goblin outside Lower Hogsfield seems distraught over his missing cart. He doesn't seem to be aligned with Ranrok's Loyalists. Perhaps I should investigate. Arn mentioned his carts were taken by Ranrok's Loyalists to an encampment to the south of Lower Hogsfield. I should try the road heading south out of the hamlet.

side:36.text: Crossed Wands is a secret unsanctioned student duelling club at Hogwarts. The club meets in the Clock Tower of Hogwarts Castle and duels are coordinated by Lucan Brattleby. The player can join the club to duel against other students, alone or with a partner, and compete for the title of Hogwarts' top duelist. The player can also use the club's training dummy to practice.

side:37.text: Crossed Wands is a secret unsanctioned student duelling club at Hogwarts. The club meets in the Clock Tower of Hogwarts Castle and duels are coordinated by Lucan Brattleby. The player can join the club to duel against other students, alone or with a partner, and compete for the title of Hogwarts' top duelist. The player can also use the club's training dummy to practice.

side:38.text: It's time to prove your duelling mettle and see if we've a new school champion. Meet me at the usual place for the final round of Crossed Wands.

side:40.text: It appears that Garreth Weasley wants to speak with me. Garreth mentioned the statue of the one-eyed witch is in the third-floor corridor. Garreth said that I needed to tap the statue with my wand and say, 'Dissendium.'

side:41.text: While visiting Irondale, I overheard a woman speaking to herself about something 'fascinating'. I should talk with her. Madam Twiddle mentioned the statue Greville spoke of is southwest of Irondale near some ruins.

side:42.text: After completing my broom flight training in Madam Kogawa's Flying class, Everett mentioned checking in with Albie Weekes at Spintwitches to get a broom. I purchased a broom from Mr Weekes and he advised I speak with Imelda Reyes at the Quidditch Pitch. She's running timed trials which are sure to be the perfect flight tests.

side:43.text: Cressida Blume has a lofty problem with her literature. Cressida's books, including her diary, are flying around the library. I need to collect all five of them for her. I've collected all of Cressida Blume's flying books. I should return them to her in the Central Hall.

side:44.text: When you have a moment, please stop by the Room of Requirement. Deek mentioned you might be interested in learning how to breed beasts.

side:45.text: I overheard Clementine Willardsey talking to herself in the Three Broomsticks. She mentioned something about a swarm of butterflies. Miss Willardsey mentioned that the butterflies are just across the bridge inside of the Forbidden Forest. I should search there. Miss Willardsey's information was accurate. I encountered the butterflies just inside the Forbidden Forest. Now to follow them deeper.

side:46.text: I noticed a small map sitting on a gravestone in the Hogsmeade Graveyard. While this may belong to someone, it might not hurt to take a peek at it in case it holds valuable information. While in Upper Hogsfield, I spied a chest behind Claire Beaumont's vendor stall that seemed to be unlocked. I wonder what could be in it. While in the Owlery, I came upon a Treasure Map at the top of the tower.

side:47.text: Zenobia Noke is fretting over her missing Gobstones. Zenobia's Gobstones are hidden around the castle. She said that the other students hid them out of her reach. They must have used magic to do it. Now that I've retrieved her Gobstones, I should return to Zenobia. She was last near the Defence Against the Dark Arts classroom.

side:48.text: Today's History of Magic class proved to be more helpful than expected. Professor Binns explained to me that Ranrok's ancestor Bragbor was an expert metal worker. I also got to learn the histories of the late tailor Grimbald Weft and Sir Affpuddle, the 'Waving Knight'.

side:49.text: Professor Weasley would like to meet with me in the Room of Requirement.

side:50.text: Eddie Thistlewood in Brocburrow seems to have an urgent matter involving Chinese Chomping Cabbages that needs attending. I should speak with him.

side:51.page: Like a Moth to a Frame
side:51.text: Lenora Everleigh appears to be looking for a clue. Perhaps I can help her investigate. Lenora mentioned that the painting revealed a clue when she cast Lumos near it. Perhaps I should try that myself. The painting revealed an image of what appears to be a location in the Central Hall. I should search the area to see if I can find it.

side:52.text: Nerida Roberts is sitting on the docks by the Hogwarts boathouse. I should go speak with her. Nerida mentioned the caves can be found in the lake west of the Hogwarts Boathouse. It sounds like I'll have to swim there. I made it into the Leaky Caves. Now I just need to find this Mermish artefact.

side:53.text: A house-elf standing outside what appears to be a vacant shop is trying to get my attention. I should see what she wants. Casandra Mason[sic] lives on the northeast side of Hogsmeade.

side:55.text: After speaking to Ferdinand's frame, your choice will have one of two outcomes

side:57.text: I dealt with the Ashwinder Silvanus Selwyn, whose band was terrorising the locals in Cragcroft. Hopefully the ongoing threats to the villagers in and around Cragcroft will lessen or vanish completely. Hyacinth Olivier offered a generous bounty and was more than elated to know that Selwyn has been dispatched.

side:58.text: The valuable item in Henrietta's Hideaway was a Musical Map. I should seek its treasure. The puzzle is found at Clagmar Castle. Note that if not already cleared out, Silvanus Selwyn and his group of Ashwinders will be here. If you know how to read sheet music, the bells are setup like a music staff and you just need to hit them as: F, B, D, C, B, F, E, and C.

side:59.text: I should see about starting a training regimen for practicing spell combinations. I'm supposed to cast Accio on the dummy to draw it close, and then hit it with a Basic Cast four times in a row. Seems simple enough, let's give it a try. Now I'm supposed to cast Levioso on the dummy and then hit it with a Basic Cast four times in a row.

side:60.text: I should see about starting a training regimen for practicing spell combinations. I'm supposed to cast Accio on the dummy to draw it close, and then hit it with a Basic Cast four times in a row. Seems simple enough, let's give it a try. Now I'm supposed to cast Levioso on the dummy and then hit it with a Basic Cast four times in a row.

side:61.text: A Hufflepuff near Dogweed and Deathcap seems to need a favour. I should see what she wants. Sacharissa told me where I should expect to find some Bubotubers in the Forbidden Forest. I should start my search there.

side:62.text: Someone is looking for a new opponent at Summoner's Court. I need to beat Leander Prewett in a single round of Summoner's Court. Summoner's Court is popular at Hogwarts. Students often gather near the board looking for new opponents to challenge. As one would imagine, the competition among the houses is fierce. Having defeated Natty Onai and Leander Prewett, I've demonstrated that I'm a capable competitor.

side:63.text:
Someone is looking for a new opponent at Summoner's Court. If the player has not yet equipped Accio:
I need to be ready to use Accio before I compete in Summoner's Court. I need to defeat Samantha Dale in a single round of Summoner's Court.

side:64.text: Someone is looking for a new opponent at Summoner's Court. It turns out that the new opponent is Grace Pinch-Smedley. I need to beat her in a round of this game if I want to advance. Grace Pinch-Smedley gave me quite a challenge at Summoner's court – she seemed rather surprised that I bested her.

side:65.text: I beat Charlotte in a game of Summoner's Court. She mentioned that there's one more opponent who'll want to test my mettle - the greatest Summoner's Court player at Hogwarts.

side:66.text: Someone is looking for a new opponent at Summoner's Court. I was able to best Professor Ronen at his own game, and became the greatest Summoner's Court player at Hogwarts.

side:67.text: Hello again. I have spectacular news: the broom upgrade is ready! Stop by the shop when you can. Look into a new broom enhancement with Albie Weekes in Spintwitches Sporting Needs. Albie mentioned that Imelda can be found south of Hogwarts. To get the data he wants, I must participate in her Broom Trial.

side:68.text: I noticed a goblin near the western bridge in Hogsmeade lamenting about a 'biscuit'. This piqued my curiosity, and I should chat with him when I have time. Garnuff said the Poacher camp was north of Hogsmeade.

side:70.text: While most of the keys can be found early on, the last three keys only become accessible after completing the Main quest, [The Caretaker's Lunar Lament], as one needs Alohomora to get into the locations they are in, and that's the level that the quest is unlocked.

side:71.text: Sophronia Franklin seems like she could use my help. She's near Charms class in the lounge. Sophronia mentioned the Hall could be found at the base of the Defence Against the Dark Arts Tower. I've found what I believe to be the entrance to the Hall of Herodiana. It was built for practising Depulso. Perhaps that will get me inside.

side:73.text: A student outside Lower Hogsfield is staring longingly out over the waters of the Black Lake. I wonder what's on her mind. According to Grace's research, the astrolabe would have sunk about a furlong northeast of the dock. I should swim out there. I found the lost astrolabe Grace was talking about. Now to return to her.

side:74.text: Hello – please forgive the sudden request, but might I speak with you? I've not heard from my Uncle Rowland in quite some time. I've been beside myself with worry. Could you meet me in the courtyard?

side:75.text: Mr Moon will teach me a more advanced form of Alohomora once I find all the Demiguise statues. I should search Hogwarts, Hogsmeade and any hamlets for the statues. I can only collect the moons from the statues at night.

side:76.text: When you have a moment, please stop by the Room of Requirement. Deek tells me he has something to share with you. Deek wants to speak to me in the Room of Requirement.

side:77.text: Hello, friend. I have thrilling news. I believe my next broom upgrade to be even more impressive than the last. I should check in with Albie Weekes to learn about his recent broom upgrade available for purchase. He can be found in Spintwitches Sporting Needs in Hogsmeade. Albie mentioned that lmelda can be found far to the southeast of Hogwarts, along the Coast.

side:80.text: A man is standing behind the Three Broomsticks, muttering angrily to himself. Should I engage? The cellar Ackley Barnes spoke of should be just down the street from the Three Broomsticks. I've found the cellar. Now I need to take a peek inside.

side:81.text: Duncan Hobhouse seems to have a Puffskein problem. I wonder if I can help him out. I should search the grounds around the Herbology wing for the entrance to the Hidden Herbology Corridor. I need to find something from the Hidden Herbology Corridor that Duncan can use to make him look brave to his classmates.

side:82.text: I came across a well southeast of Aranshire inside some old ruins and heard a voice coming from it. I should investigate it. I have obtained a treasure map from a talking well near Aranshire. I should try to find where it leads.

boss:2.text: The ultimate test for those seeking the deepest secrets of Ancient Magic, these sentries can only be defeated through the same magic that powers them. As they summon Ancient Magic into a powerful orb attack, the orb can be exploded to neutralise and repurpose that magic for your own benefit. The way to destroy Pensieve Guardian's powerful orb attack is to use magic of the same color as the orb to attack the orb.

boss:3.text: Victor Rookwood is the criminal leader of the Rookwood Gang in Hogwarts Legacy. Victor was a descendant of Charles Rookwood but by the time of Victor's father's era, the family had gone from being respectful, law-abiding citizens to running crime rings, though their family name still carried some weight in the magical community. As such, Victor was taught to bend the law when he could, and break it when necessary.

boss:4.text: During his youth, Ranrok one day came across an illegal dragon-breeding camp run by wizards and was fascinated by the creatures. He'd then visit the camp in secret whenever he could to see them before finally mustering the courage after several weeks to speak to the wizard in charge as he wished to join them.

collectible:1.text: Merlin Trials are a series of small spell-based puzzles spread throughout the magical open world. These Trials are designed to test the player's skills and knowledge of spells, and are scattered so frequently that it's almost impossible to take a few steps without stumbling upon them.

collectible:2.text: Demiguise statues begin to appear in Hogsmeade during the quest Welcome to Hogsmeade, and in Hogwarts the next day, but their significance does not become apparent until the player receives a request from Gladwin Moon.

collectible:3.text: While most of the keys can be found early on, the last three keys only become accessible after completing the Main quest, [The Caretaker's Lunar Lament], as one needs Alohomora to get into the locations they are in, and that's the level that the quest is unlocked.

main:35.text: Lodgok asked me to meet him at a goblin mine south of Hogwarts and asked that I bring someone who speaks Gobbledegook. The mine that Lodgok discovered is located to the south of Hogwarts on the other side of the lake. Amit will join us there. We can't risk Lodgok being seen entering the mine with us – it's too dangerous for him. So now it's up to Amit and me to search the mine and figure out what Ranrok is up to.

main:37.text: I need to speak to Professor Fig about how to get into the Headmaster's office. The Keepers have something planned for me there. I've taken the Polyjuice Potion, and now I need to find Madam Kogawa. She may know more about the Headmaster's house-elf, named Scrope. I need to speak to the Headmaster's house-elf, Scrope, to learn the password into his office.

main:40.text: Lodgok is attempting to infiltrate the Coastal Mine alone. I need to find him. I have located the entrance to the mine. There's no sign of Lodgok – he must have gone inside. I need to locate Lodgok. He must be somewhere in this mine. But the place appears to be full of Ranrok's loyalists. I'll need to be careful.

main:42.text: I need to visit Mr Ollivander in his shop and see if he can craft the Keepers' wand with the artefacts I acquired from their trials. I've been ambushed by Rookwood and his lot. They've taken me to a secure location and are trying to take the wand from me by force. I must fight for my life! It's time to finish things between Victor Rookwood and me – once and for all.

main:43.text: The Final Repository is a main quest in Hogwarts Legacy.

side:3.text: Natty sent me another owl saying that she can sneak away without her mother knowing. I'm to meet her outside Hogsmeade. Natty wants me to speak with the late Mr Bickle's associates to see what information they have on Harlow. I should be able to find them in Hogsmeade. I was able to speak with Otto Dibble, Agabus Philbert and Daisy Rabe, the wife of Isko Rabe, as Mr Rabe has gone missing.

side:6.text: Natty sent me an owl requesting I meet her near Manor Cape. That's a distance from Hogwarts. She must have a good lead on Harlow. I should prepare before meeting her. We believe Harlow plans to ambush us at the manor. We're not afraid, because we have the upper hand, as he's unaware that we've uncovered his trickery. I'll follow Natty there. We've reached the manor. It's eerily quiet.

side:7.text: I need to visit Natty in the hospital wing and thank her for leaping in front of Theophilus Harlow's attack to save me. I visited Natty in the hospital wing and was encouraged to see that she is in good spirits as she recovers from her injuries. She realised that she is no more to blame for her father's death than I am to blame for her injury. She has a lot of her father in her, as she saved me without hesitation.

side:9.text: Poppy sent me an owl saying she knows where we need to return the dragon egg we have in our possession. I'm to meet her in Hogsmeade's town circle. Poppy was able to track the dragon we freed to this location. Her nest should be straight ahead. The dragon sees us, no use in hiding. There must be a way to return the egg without harming her.

side:10.text: I should talk to Poppy and find out why she left so abruptly after we returned the dragon egg. Poppy and I were able to save a dragon from the clutches of Victor Rookwood's Poacher Pack, but this heroism came at a price. The poachers identified Poppy and went to her gran's house in search of the dragon's egg.

side:11.text: Last I talked to Poppy, she was worried about the Snidgets. She said to meet her in the Forbidden Forest to figure out our rescue plan. I spoke with Poppy about her plan to rescue the Snidgets. It involved the aid of the centaurs. One named Dorran seems open to helping us.

side:12.text: Poppy sent me an owl saying that she wants to meet near Irondale at a cave south of Hogwarts. The Tomb is near Irondale, to the south of Hogwarts. I've heard most people tend to avoid this place, but nevertheless, we must go inside. The moonstone we seek is surely hiddenm away in here somewhere.

side:14.text: Dorran suspects he knows where the Snidgets were hidden. Poppy and I are meeting him southwest of Brocburrow to investigate it. I met Poppy at the ruins that bore the same symbol as the one the Mooncalves left behind. She says Dorran is waiting for us ahead. Best to meet with him now. We were able to solve the puzzle to enter the Gilded Perch. Now to find those Snidgets.

side:15.text: Poppy and I beat the poachers and saved the Snidgets. I wonder how she feels about it all. I should meet her in the Great Hall and talk to her. Poppy and I rescued a dragon from the Poacher Pack and stole a dragon egg. They retaliated by stealing a journal from her gran with information as to the location of Snidgets, believed to be extinct. Poppy sought the help of the centaurs but only one was willing to help us.

side:28.text: A vendor in Aranshire seems to need help with something. I need to find the Absconder's Cave. It should be in the Forbidden Forest to the northwest of Hogsmeade. I've located the cave of the Absconder. I should dispatch of the Absconder before attempting to look for Milo's heirloom.

side:39.text: While exploring the basement of an old manor near the Southern Coast. I came upon a locked chest. I should unlock the chest to see what it holds. The map portrays stone monoliths near a waterfall along with a series of floor tiles that contain symbols on them. I reached the location denoted by the Mysterious Map Fragment from the locked chest I found in an old manor.

side:54.text: I wonder what Deek wants to talk with me about. I need to speak with him. Deek believes the phoenix is nesting in the mountains far to the southeast of Hogwarts. This appears to be the location that Deek heard about - perhaps the phoenix is inside. I should enter the cave and take a look.

side:56.text: The vendor in Bainburgh seems to be worried about 'her poor boy'. It sounds like she needs help. To find Rococo, I need to find the castle belonging to the late Henrietta. Miss Coffey noted it's south of Bainburgh. I've found Henrietta's Hideway. Now to find a way in.

side:69.text: Crispin Dunne in the Three Broomsticks is looking for someone to check on a friend. I told Crispin Dunne that I would travel to Aranshire and check on his friend Mary. Aranshire is under attack - I need to destroy the spiders and protect the village!

side:72.text: While exploring Poidsear Castle in the Southern Coast. I noticed an important-looking rolled parchment resting on a table within the castle grounds. Henrietta's Map portrays castle ruins on a peninsula. A hippogriff surrounded by flames is also etched onto it. The infamous Henrietta's Hideaway was home to the treasure alluded to in the map.

side:78.text: Betty Bugbrooke is terribly worried about her unicorn friend Hazel who was injured protecting her from wolves. It seems Betty often visits Hazen in the Forbidden Forest to brush her and bring her treats. She is concerned for Hazel's safety due to increasing poacher presence and Hazel's injury. She's hopeful someone can find and take Hazel somewhere safe to heal.

side:79.text: Upon approaching Brocburrow, I overhead a woman talking about a problem with a troll. I should speak with her. I've spoken with Alexandra Ricketts, who requested I dispatch a troll she's been unsuccessfully training. It can be found south of Brocburrow. I've found Alexandra's Troll's den to the south of Brocburrow. This troll seems more formidable than other trolls. I should be careful.

boss:1.text: A named Graphorn, The Lord of the Shore, is acquired as a mount by completing San Bakar's Trial towards the end of the main story. The same den can be revisited afterwards to get more Graphorns (one per visit). Due to their aggressive nature, Graphorns are more difficult to capture than other beasts. They must be weakened by fighting before they can be pulled into the Nab-Sack.
